properties.notes: Borough Local Plan (2005) policy Cf1 resists the loss of community buildings or uses unless there is no longer a need for them, or adequate alternative provision is to be made elsewhere in the locality and no other community facility or service can make use of the premises or site. Surrey County Council has recently agreed to relocate the library to the former Newman House site. The site has been identified in the Regulation 19 Development Management Plan for mixed-use community, car parking and residential development (HOR5). Land to the rear of the library is partially at risk of surface water flooding.
